authored.goals: A front-desk user with valid credentials reaches the clinic overview without a full-page reload

A front-desk user books a consultation for the first listed doctor, confirms it, and the API records the new appointment (the app exposes the same wizard from the 'New appointment' desk, which is used here because the doctor directory renders only after a client-side delay that the baseline recorder cannot observe)
Entering age 150 in the booking form is rejected: the step-1 validation fires before any slot or confirmation (business rule B1)
An emergency visit review screen shows a doctor fee of INR 0.00 and a total of INR 0.00 (business rule B2)
The billing invoice TOTAL exactly equals the sum of all displayed line-item amounts (business rule B3)
Cancel an appointment; verify confirmation dialog appears before removal and row is removed after confirming (B6)
Navigate to the doctor directory after login, observe the loading skeleton state, wait, and verify all eight doctors are shown
Change the SMS reminders custom toggle switch and verify the preference is saved via the API
